definitions.explanation: An interrogative word used to ask which month of the year something occurs in or relates to. One of the most basic question words for dates in Japanese.

examples.japanese: {誕生日|たんじょうび}は{何月|なんがつ}ですか。
{桜|さくら}は{何月|なんがつ}に{咲|さ}きますか。
examples.english: In what month do the cherry blossoms bloom?

examples.japanese: {何月|なんがつ}{何日|なんにち}に{届|とど}くか、まだ{連絡|れんらく}が{来|き}ていない。
examples.english: I haven't received word yet about what month and day it will arrive.

notes:
The interrogative form for months, combining {何|なん} (what) with {月|がつ} (month). One of the most basic and frequently used question words for dates. Used when asking about specific months for events, schedules, seasons, etc.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {何月|なんがつ}ですか: what month is it?
- {何月|なんがつ}に: in what month
- {何月|なんがつ}{何日|なんにち}: what month and day
- {何月|なんがつ}{頃|ごろ}: around what month

RELATED DATE QUESTIONS:
- {何日|なんにち} — what day (of the month)
- {何曜日|なんようび} — what day of the week
- {何年|なんねん} — what year
- {何時|なんじ} — what time
